| A4 Prusa CORE One | 1282 | -0.248 | -0.060 | no | A1, A2 |

### Reading the frontier: best printer (max φ benefit) for each budget

| budget from [EUR] | best choice | φ benefit |

| 800 | nothing affordable | – |
| 899 | A2 Snapmaker U1 | -0.000 |
